messages:
Alex Chen: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Alex Chen: did the vuln triage for the 3 Snyk alerts, marked two as low-risk (deps only) and filed PR for the nginx CVE fix (PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/482)
Alex Chen: blocker: need approval for KMS key rotation window from compliance (email sent to @Priya)

Priya Patel: saw the PR, will review today. thx for splitting the nginx fix out.
Priya Patel: for KMS rotation window — can we avoid 2pm-4pm Wed? finance batch runs then. prefer Thu morning.

Sam Rodriguez: quick heads-up: I ran smoke on staging after the patch, no auth regressions. left one flaky test, looks unrelated to key handling.
Sam Rodriguez: pinging @Maria for infra deploy permission to proceed with prod patch once PR approved.

Maria Gomez: noted. I can do prod deploy Thu 09:30 if compliance signs off. add me to the release ticket.
Maria Gomez: ACL change for the KMS admin role — Sam, can you attach the minimal policy snippet?

Sam Rodriguez: sure, snippet below:
```
- Effect: Allow
  Action:
    - kms:Decrypt
    - kms:GenerateDataKey
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
Sam Rodriguez: will post as a PR to infra-iam.

Priya Patel: confirming compliance: we need a one-line justification for the rotation in the ticket (rotate due to CVE patching cadence). I'll add it now.

Alex Chen: added the quick eval notes to the ticket and linked the PR. also set a temp fallback model routing in case the patch causes perf regressions (:crossed_fingers:)

KeyOpsBot: scheduled KMS rotation dry-run for 2024-11-08T09:00Z in staging. Notifying oncall 24h prior.

Maria Gomez: thanks @KeyOpsBot — if dry-run looks good we'll proceed with prod Thu.

Priya Patel: review ETA 2 hours. if anything blocks, i'll flag here.

Alex Chen: other items: audit export for last 30 days ready (CSV attached to ticket). if anyone needs a column added lmk.

Sam Rodriguez: no columns needed for me. thanks for pulling that.

Priya Patel: one more ask — can someone grep logs for repeated DecryptDenied entries after the patch? if we see uptick, rollback plan B is ready.

Alex Chen: I'll run a quick query and post results by EOD.

Maria Gomez: final: reminder to add changelog notes under security-release.md in the repo.

Alex Chen: will do. end of my updates. :thumbsup:
